Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class TrigXFadeEventBase< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a TrigXFade UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use TrigXFadeEventBase<void> or TrigXFadeEventBase<> if there's no owner.

See also:
TrigXFade , TrigXFadeEventBase<void>
